title: The Martian
author: Andy Weir
description: An astronaut stranded on Mars fights to survive.
internal_notes: Perennial staff pick; keep face-out on the sci-fi endcap.

title: The Road
author: Cormac McCarthy
description: A father and son journey through a post-apocalyptic landscape.
internal_notes: Assign to the book-club table in October.

title: Project Hail Mary
author: Andy Weir
description: A lone astronaut wakes with no memory and must save Earth from an extinction-level threat.
internal_notes: Customers who liked The Martian ask for this; shelve nearby.

title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: A young nobleman is drawn into a war for a desert planet and its spice.
internal_notes: Movie tie-in cover sells faster than the classic cover.

title: Gone Girl
author: Gillian Flynn
description: A wife disappears and a marriage's secrets unravel under investigation.
internal_notes: Restock delayed; distributor backorder until August.

title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
author: Stieg Larsson
description: A journalist and a hacker investigate a decades-old disappearance.
internal_notes: Series sells as a set; bundle with volumes 2 and 3.

title: Educated
author: Tara Westover
description: A memoir of leaving a survivalist family for a university education.
internal_notes: Frequent gift purchase; keep near the register in December.

title: The Silent Patient
author: Alex Michaelides
description: A psychotherapist becomes obsessed with a patient who refuses to speak.
internal_notes: Demand spike from social media; reorder threshold raised to 12.

title: Where the Crawdads Sing
author: Delia Owens
description: An abandoned girl raises herself in the marshes of North Carolina.
internal_notes: Damaged shipment returned; awaiting replacement stock.

title: The Hobbit
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: A homebody hobbit is swept into a quest to reclaim a dwarven kingdom.
internal_notes: Evergreen seller; never let stock drop below 6.
